sections.title: Shipping Rates
sections.body: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $150 within the continental US. Standard shipping is $8.99 for orders under $150. Express shipping starts at $14.99.

sections.title: Delivery Times
sections.body: Standard: 5-8 business days. Express: 2-3 business days. International: 10-14 business days. Delivery times are estimates and may vary during peak seasons or due to customs processing.

sections.title: Order Processing
sections.body: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You'll receive a confirmation email once your order ships, along with a tracking number.

sections.title: Tracking Your Order
sections.body: Once shipped, you'll receive a tracking link via email. You can also check your order status in your account dashboard.

sections.title: International Shipping
sections.body: We ship to 50+ countries. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout and are the responsibility of the customer. Delivery times vary by destination.

sections.title: Shipping Restrictions
sections.body: We currently do not ship to PO boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Some oversized items may have additional shipping surcharges.
